method: roster value = sum over the top-18 opening skaters (events in the first 5 games) of last-season individual raw xG per game, minus the same for last season's closing roster; replacement value (10th pct) for players without a prior season; the difference enters as d_roster, fading to 0 by 30 GP. Walk-forward (train < S), games where either team has <= 15 GP.
caveat: offense-only value (shot-level data has no historical shifts for RAPM); the opening roster uses games 1-5, a slight look-ahead for games 2-5 lineups (not results)
rule: ship only if early-season log loss improves by >= 0.002 in both 2024 and 2025
decision: disabled: improvement below 0.002 in at least one season
